name: argus-polymer-ceramic-thermal-conductivity
title: Source-verified thermal conductivity of polymer-ceramic composites (epoxy + BN/AlN)
description: Experimental effective thermal conductivity of polymer-ceramic composites, primarily epoxy filled with h-BN, BN nanosheets and AlN (thermal interface and packaging materials). Every row is traceable to a table, figure or sentence of an open-access source; no value is estimated or inferred.
